subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose current-session reset authority to after-compaction plugin hooks, and should automatic terminal tool-loop resets be part of that same core contract?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin API and changes session-reset policy across embedded, Codex, Copilot, cron, reply, and gateway ownership boundaries; tests can validate an implementation but cannot choose the permanent API or automatic-reset policy.

options.title: Narrow and sponsor the hook API
options.body: Approve only the scoped after-compaction reset contract, remove unrelated loop and schema changes, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the broad recovery policy
options.body: Accept the hook API, deterministic tool-loop abort/reset behavior, and cross-caller persistence changes as one coordinated core policy after broader owner review.

options.title: Pause the core API
options.body: Withhold the plugin contract until maintainers define reset authority, locked-session behavior, failure reporting, and upgrade guarantees.

recommendation.title: Narrow and sponsor the hook API
recommendation.body: Approve only the scoped after-compaction reset contract, remove unrelated loop and schema changes, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged schema decision and compaction/session history make this the best available owner for the combined product and compatibility choice.
